Malaysia serves as a major Southeast Asian hub for medical technology, hosting global multinational manufacturing plants and large local rubber-derived medical product giants. Key industry leaders include global giants like **B. Braun**, **Abbott**, **Boston Scientific**, and **Smith & Nephew**, alongside major local manufacturers such as **Top Glove** and **Hartalega**. [](https://360digitmg.com/blog/medical-equipment-manufacturing-companies-in-malaysia)

Many of the world's top medical device companies have major production plants anchored in regional hubs like Penang and Johor: [](https://investpenang.gov.my/medical-devices/)

- **B. Braun:** A massive German medical and pharmaceutical device manufacturer with extensive production facilities in Penang focusing on surgical instruments and IV access systems.

- **Abbott:**

Operates high-tech manufacturing operations for scientific instruments and diagnostics.

- **Boston Scientific:** Produces less-invasive medical devices, cardiac and vascular instruments.

- **Smith & Nephew:** Operates advanced orthopedic and sports medicine manufacturing facilities.

- **Dexcom:** Manufactures continuous glucose monitoring systems locally. [](https://investpenang.gov.my/medical-devices/)

### Local Medical Equipment & Consumables Giants

Malaysia is a world leader in rubber-based medical disposables and examination equipment: [](https://360digitmg.com/blog/medical-equipment-manufacturing-companies-in-malaysia)

- **Top Glove Corporation Bhd:** Primarily known globally as the largest rubber glove manufacturer, producing diverse medical examination and surgical gloves.

- **Hartalega Holdings Berhad:** A pioneer in advanced nitrile glove manufacturing and high-grade examination products.

- **Kossan Rubber Industries Berhad:** Produces specialized medical-grade rubber products and cleanroom supplies.

- **Supermax Corporation Berhad:** Manufactures latex and nitrile medical gloves distributed globally. [](https://360digitmg.com/blog/medical-equipment-manufacturing-companies-in-malaysia)
